{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-de-d","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"16ddc248409d65d5f1f43cb28a48aa8013d08a248fd6852f0ee91539684b8795","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-de-class-d:lineage:45","source_registry_sha256":"7b6c7aeec232df29a8679bf39181604be2d91ce9a1cb4fcc709fed49cbe724bb","source_liveness_sha256":"53bd779b9965bd9d51630c8d8d055ccdc52a4d8ec7117a3b87241fc5129eb44f"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Parking, speed restrictions and initial pedestrian duties","heading":"C — Parking, speed restrictions and initial pedestrian duties","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C — Parking, speed restrictions and initial pedestrian duties

FACT_ID: sec10-F01 | anchor: A01
Before leaving a vehicle parked on a street or highway, shut off its engine, lock the ignition, take the key and apply the brakes. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F02 | anchor: A01
The handbook also recommends closing the windows and locking the doors when leaving a parked vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F03 | anchor: A01
On a two-way highway, park parallel to the curb or road edge and no farther than 12 inches away. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F04 | anchor: A01
Before parallel parking, check behind you; if a vehicle follows too closely, continue to another space instead of stopping abruptly. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F05 | anchor: A01
Begin parallel parking by signaling and stopping with your vehicle’s rear aligned with the rear of the vehicle ahead of the desired space. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F06 | anchor: A01
For right-curb parallel parking, reverse slowly while steering right to aim your rear toward the vehicle behind the space. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F07 | anchor: A01
After your front clears the vehicle ahead, steer sharply left and continue reversing slowly until near the vehicle behind. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F08 | anchor: A01
Finish parallel parking by straightening the wheels, moving forward to center the vehicle, selecting Park, applying the brake and shutting off the engine. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F09 | anchor: A01
Leaving the keys in a running unattended vehicle is unlawful. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F10 | anchor: A01
For parallel parking at a one-way street’s left curb, reverse the right and left directions in the parking procedure. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F11 | anchor: A01
Leave a manual-transmission vehicle in low gear when parked facing uphill. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F12 | anchor: A01
Leave a manual-transmission vehicle in reverse when parked facing downhill. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F13 | anchor: A01
Before leaving a parallel-parking space, signal, check traffic, steer toward the open lane and move out gradually. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F14 | anchor: A01
A designated accessible parking space requires either a displayed rear accessible plate or a parking ID card hanging at the rear-view mirror. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F15 | anchor: A01
A vehicle parked along a highway from sunset to sunrise must display parking lights or, if equipped, four-way flashers. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F16 | anchor: A01
Parking lights or equipped four-way flashers are also required along a highway when light is inadequate to see people or objects 1,000 feet away. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F17 | anchor: A01
A parked vehicle must not flash turn signals on just one side. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec10-F18 | anchor: A02
Outside a business or residential area, do not park on a highway’s paved or traveled portion unless the vehicle is disabled and immovable; move as far right as possible. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F19 | anchor: A02
For downhill parking, turn the front wheels toward the curb or roadway edge. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F20 | anchor: A02
For uphill parking beside a curb, turn the front wheels away from it and bring the nearer front wheel against the curb. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F21 | anchor: A02
For uphill parking without a curb, turn the front wheels toward the highway edge. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F22 | anchor: A02
Do not open a parked vehicle’s door into traffic or danger; use the curb-side door when possible and check for approaching vehicles and cyclists before using the street-side door. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F23 | anchor: A02
The stopping-and-parking prohibitions allow exceptions for contrary postings, police orders or crash avoidance, and apply even when someone remains in the vehicle. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F24 | anchor: A02
Unless a stated exception applies, do not stop or park where an official sign forbids it. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F25 | anchor: A02
Unless a stated exception applies, do not stop or park beside a yellow-painted curb or a yellow road-edge line. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F26 | anchor: A02
Unless a stated exception applies, stopping or parking is barred within an intersection, directly on its crosswalk, and for 20 feet from that crosswalk. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F27 | anchor: A02
Unless a stated exception applies, stopping or parking on a sidewalk is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F28 | anchor: A02
Unless a stated exception applies, do not stop or park in front of a road, alley or driveway, whether public or private. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F29 | anchor: A02
Unless a stated exception applies, remain at least 15 feet from a hydrant when stopping or parking. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F30 | anchor: A02
Unless a stated exception applies, do not stop or park within 20 feet of a fire-station driveway entrance. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec10-F31 | anchor: A02
With signs posted, the stopping-and-parking restriction across from a fire-station entrance extends 75 feet, subject to the stated exceptions. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0092]
